scope: All 330 O4 BONES CSV files (651970 rows), 132 O3 quarter16k/32k BONES CSV files (260788 rows), and five O4 LAFAN40 CSV files (200 rows) independently read. No new rollout.

failure_window_schema.source: same final formal BONES evaluation; no additional physics or WM calls
failure_window_schema.context_values: raw environment values (un-normalized); COM is actual body_ipos, not offset from baseline
failure_window_schema.env_origin: environment world origin; root_pos in robot_state has already subtracted it
failure_window_schema.state_alignment: initial state and each returned post-step state; references at corresponding advanced frame
failure_window_schema.window: k=min(32,transitions before and including first hard failure); k+1 states, k actions/rewards; no padding

row_validation_note: All scored rows validated for unique original source IDs, stable name/category/package/frame-count identity across seven BONES nodes, finite numeric values, R=reward_sum/(0.1*(N-1)), completion=executed/(N-1), full completion implying all transitions. Raw reward component sums differ from native reward sums by <=5.95e-6, consistent with accumulation precision; no claim of bit-identical component summation. Formal quality metrics average only executed states, so comparisons on common-complete sets are also reported. Duration bins use reference motion length, not failure time.
